scope: Every finding was produced by reading the committed files or the linked official page during this session.

rows.finding: Eight separate NBA workspaces coexist with overlapping scope and no single canonical dataset.
rows.evidence: docs/, lab/, lines-lab/, nba-evidence/, own4-dashboard/, pages/ + official/, research/ + data/, and the pre-existing root dashboard. 158 HTML pages in total.
rows.resolution: This session publishes one canonical dashboard at /nba-lines/site/ and one clean root landing page; earlier workspaces are preserved and labelled, not deleted.

rows.finding: Correlation coefficients are published for a 49,226 player-game dataset spanning 2010-11 to 2023-24, but that dataset is not in the repository and cannot be rebuilt from anything committed.
rows.evidence: data/correlations_computed.json cites dataset_commit a5f108b5b1f08074d78b9e8e901926a9ce4c06c5 with n=49226. No file of that size or shape exists in the repo (largest data file: data/player_gamelogs.json, 2,509 rows).
rows.resolution: Either commit the dataset with its licence, or withdraw the coefficients. This session does not rely on them: every correlation it publishes is recomputed from files committed here.

rows.finding: The committed 'raw' nba.com pages cannot regenerate the results dataset: the server-rendered game cards contain empty score containers, so scores are only present after client-side rendering.
rows.evidence: data/raw/nba/games_2026-11-01.html contains GameCardMatchup_matchupScoreCardWrapper with no score text, and MatchupCardTeamRecord_record rendered as '-'.
rows.resolution: Verification instead uses an aggregate reconciliation: the 121 committed finals reproduce all 30 official W-L records exactly (30/30, zero mismatches).

rows.finding: Several source manifest entries record HTTP 403 or timeouts against cdn.nba.com and stats.nba.com, yet parts of the documentation describe those endpoints as if they had been used.
rows.evidence: data/manifest.json: scheduleLeagueV2 and todaysScoreboard_00 return 403; stats.nba.com leaguestandingsv3 returns TimeoutError; fetch.log repeats the failures.
rows.resolution: Treat 403/timeout entries as failures, not as sources. This session records only pages it actually read.

rows.finding: An automated collector downloaded roughly 47 MB of ESPN box-score JSON, which is in tension with the league's stated restriction on downloading its statistics, and ESPN is not the league.
rows.evidence: data/raw/espn holds 121 JSON files (47 MB). The NBA Stats FAQ states the league's stats 'are not available for download for either academic or personal use'.
rows.resolution: This session performs no automated league harvesting; its captures are 121 finals, 30 standings rows, 2 slate entries and 13 availability rows transcribed from displayed pages. Whether to keep the ESPN extract is a decision for the repository owner.

rows.finding: A workflow is hard-coded to another session's branch and therefore never runs against main; its commit step also rebases onto that dead branch.
rows.evidence: .github/workflows/fetch-nba-data.yml pins ref and push targets to arena/75685c60-own4.
rows.resolution: Repoint to main and add a licence/terms check before re-enabling, or disable it. Left untouched here because it is outside this session's file scope.

rows.finding: Two different 'Flagged for Review' pages exist with different contents, so 'the flagged list' is ambiguous.
rows.resolution: The canonical flagged list for this session is /nba-lines/site/governance/flagged.html.

rows.finding: The shared board records contradictory outcomes for the same pull request in two different session entries.
rows.evidence: One entry states 'PR #5 merge was rejected as not cleanly mergeable'; a later entry in the same section states 'PR #5 merged during PR #4 checks'.
rows.resolution: Read the GitHub PR timeline, not the board, for merge state. This session appends its own record without altering earlier entries.

rows.finding: data/signals.json attributes a computed home-win rate to the standings page, which is a provenance mislabel: a standings table does not contain per-game home/away outcomes.
rows.evidence: data/signals.json item SIG-01 'Home win rate (2026-27 to date)' with value 0.5217, k=48, n=92, source_url https://www.nba.com/standings.
rows.resolution: Computed values must cite the per-game source, not an aggregate page. This session cites the game page on every result row.

rows.finding: The 2025-26 prior-season team table is a hand transcription; it passes internal consistency (30 teams, every GP=82, sum of plus-minus per game = -0.2) but was not re-read page by page in this session.
rows.evidence: data/team_stats_2025-26.csv; engine.prior_check() result published in the verification report.
rows.resolution: Re-read and re-transcribe before relying on it for anything beyond a shrinkage prior.

rows.finding: Individual player game logs stop at 2026-11-01, so the player-level layer is three days stale relative to the 2026-11-05 slate.
rows.evidence: data/player_gamelogs.json covers 13 dates, 2026-10-20 through 2026-11-01; the results set reaches 2026-11-04.
rows.resolution: Props in this release are anchored on the official season averages from the slate page; the log layer is used only for volatility and correlation.

rows.finding: Two rosters disagree with 2025-26 expectations (Giannis Antetokounmpo listed with Miami, Tyler Herro with Milwaukee). Checked rather than assumed: three independent official pages agree.
rows.evidence: The 11/05 injury PDF lists Antetokounmpo under Miami Heat; the 11/02 recap lists Herro under MIL; the 11/05 slate card lists Antetokounmpo as MIA season leader.
rows.resolution: Not an irregularity in this repo; recorded so a reader does not mistake it for a transcription error.

rows.finding: The inherited canonical site does pass its own link checker: 11 pages, 758 links, 438 table rows, 0 problems.
rows.evidence: python3 scripts/check_site.py output, re-run during this review.
rows.resolution: Recorded as a positive control: the earlier workspaces are internally consistent even where their claims are unverifiable.

rows.finding: The overtime flag on inherited result rows is a transcription convention (blank means 'not marked OT on the page'), not an independently verified field.
rows.evidence: data/games_2026-27.csv marks exactly 4 games 'OT' and leaves 88 blank; this session's 3 captured overtime finals are marked from pages that render 'Final/OT'.
rows.resolution: Treat the column as informative only; it is never used as a model input.

rows.finding: Two workspaces in the same repository publish opposite headline results for the same question. The root executive summary reports 1 trial and 5 of 11 parlay constructions passing every gate; the nba-evidence workspace reports zero qualified strategies and zero rewards; the lab reports that no strategy passes its pre-registered gates.
rows.evidence: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md lines 10-11 vs nba-evidence/docs/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md line 5 and nba-evidence/README.md. The summary's inputs (4,144 holdout games, 10,327 dev games) are not in the repository, so neither side of the contradiction can be adjudicated from committed data.
rows.resolution: This session's summary replaces the root file with a canonical, reproducible result and retains the earlier text verbatim in an appendix labelled superseded. The contradiction is recorded rather than silently resolved: the earlier claim cannot be verified because its dataset is absent.

rows.finding: The board already contains a documented self-correction of a doubled '/site/site/' publication path, and the corrected path resolves.
rows.evidence: Closing entry of session 91dfd6a4 records the correction to /nba-evidence/site/.
rows.resolution: No action; recorded so this review is not silent about it.
